title: Fennel White Bean and Kale Soup

ingredients.name: kale, or escarole, swiss chard or spinach

steps.instruction: Heat 1/2 cup of olive oil in a large soup pot over medium heat.
Add 2 small diced fennel bulbs and 2 small diced yellow onions.
Stir in 4 teaspoons of minced rosemary for 4 minutes, until tender.
steps.spoken: Stir in 4 teaspoons of minced fresh rosemary or thyme. Keep stirring for 4 to six minutes, until the fennel and onions are tender.

steps.instruction: Add 10 cloves of minced garlic and 1/2 to 1 teaspoon of red pepper flakes.
steps.spoken: Add 10 cloves of minced garlic and 1/2 to 1 teaspoon of red pepper flakes. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.

steps.instruction: Add 10 to 12 ounces of kale, a handful at a time.
steps.spoken: Add 10 to 12 ounces of kale, a handful at a time. Add the kale one handful at a time, stirring until the leaves wilt. Escarole, swiss chard or spinach can be used instead.

steps.instruction: Add 4 cans of rinsed cannellini beans, 4 cups of broth and black pepper.
Bring the soup to a boil, then turn it down to a simmer.
Simmer for 6 minutes, mashing some beans with a wooden spoon.
steps.spoken: Simmer for 6 to eight minutes, mashing some of the beans with a wooden spoon, until the liquid has reduced.

steps.instruction: Take the pot off the heat and stir in 2 tablespoons of lemon juice.
Stir in 6 tablespoons of grated parmesan.
